child_boundaries.proof: batch1152: XOR EAX,EAX; first test may MOV EAX,1; at most three INC EAX; RET. Caller CMP/TEST EAX is represented exactly by C char promotion for range0..4. No fabricated upper EAX.

child_boundaries.native_consumption: TEST AL only; argument kind zero-extended BYTE (4A233B XOR EAX,4A233D MOV AL,4A2340 PUSH EAX)
AL-only child result. Typed return uint8_t exposes only consumed low8; no zeroed GPR frame.

child_boundaries.native_outputs: Two actual private DWORD pointers; no fabricated pointed values in C. Real child writes are retained; declaration only specifies pointer width.

unresolved_limits: Finite baseline cases cover the declared child endpoints, not all external helper domains or all-game equivalence.

446A30: optional-coordinate count zero with population nonzero reads native uninitialized caller-stack workspace. Candidate leaves that workspace uninitialized; no guessed coordinates/zero frame introduced. Caller-domain qualification remains required beyond present fixtures.
4E7200: normal signed IDIV arithmetic is retained; zero-denominator fault context/flags are not established by these normal-domain cases.
4F3690 scalar computation is retained but known direct callers discard it; unrestricted indirect-consumer/result-flags coverage is not claimed.
No candidate C compilation or emulation was run by this author; root owns strict compile, shared link and baseline/candidate replay.
